profile.headline: Software Engineer at Nuro
profile.summary:
I am currently a software engineer at Nuro.

Before Nuro, I worked as a software engineer at LinkedIn for 9 years. I worked on stream processing infrastructure, and I am a committer for Apache Samza. I also worked on multiple application backends. Notable technologies I have significant experience with are Java, Kubernetes, Samza, Kafka, and Gradle. I have also worked with languages like Python and C++ in the past.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Samza stream processing: Apache Samza is an open source stream processing framework, and I am a committer for the project. I have contributed to many parts of this platform, such as the processing engine (Java), resource management in YARN and Kubernetes, CI/CD, and build tools (Gradle).
- Member notifications: I worked on a team which built a new platform for making decisions about how LinkedIn communicates with its members. Relevant technologies include Java, Samza, and Kafka.
- Ingested content and user-generated content: I worked on designing and building a system to store metadata about content found on the web. I also worked on components involving shares on the home page and the publishing platform.

positions.title: Undergraduate Robotics Research
positions.description: I worked with ROS (Robotics Operating System) and the PR2 robot. In the semester of Spring 2012, I worked on implementing the Lightning Path Planning Framework in ROS (Python, C++). The project is open source and is located here: https://sourceforge.net/projects/lightningros/

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: I worked on content acquisition at Linkedin. This work involved back-end programming and simple front-end programming. This work also involved setting up internal API endpoints. I used Java, TestNG, HTML, Javascript, and other internal tools at Linkedin.

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description:
I worked on the same project on which I had worked during the summer of 2010.
During this summer, I worked on testing and improving the efficiency of the scripts that did the setup of a virtual machine cluster onto the cloud. I analyzed the efficiency of the old tool and then wrote new scripts, which significantly improved the efficiency. I also added error handling functionality to the deployment scripts.
- Python, SimPy

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description:
I worked on a project which had the goal of creating software tool that allowed researchers to easily set up their own work environment on the cloud to do work on it. The tool would automatically deploy a virtual machine cluster of the researcher's choice onto the cloud.
I worked on an online monitoring system for the tool, which displayed the status of the deployment of the virtual machine cluster.
- Python, HTML, Javascript, TurboGears
